question: Should `openclawProgressKind: "tool-progress"` and `isToolProgressPayload` become the permanent public Plugin SDK contract for transient tool progress?
rationale: The implementation is additive and technically sound, but publishing this seam lets external plugins depend on its name and semantics; repository policy requires explicit ownership judgment for Plugin SDK expansion.

options.title: Approve the generic contract
options.body: Keep the additive generic kind and predicate because producer-owned progress intent is reusable and avoids channel-specific text inference.

options.title: Keep it internal
options.body: Move the marker behind an internal runtime seam if only bundled Codex and Slack should exchange this intent.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic contract
recommendation.body: Keep the additive generic kind and predicate because producer-owned progress intent is reusable and avoids channel-specific text inference.

likelyOwner.reason: The current shared progress-payload and Slack dispatch architecture traces to this person's recent work, making them the best available owner for the public-boundary decision.
